name: Mango Simulator
desc:
🥭 Mango Simulator 🍀🐾 Collect. Hatch. Trade. Become the Mango Master!

Welcome to Mango Simulator, the ultimate tropical adventure where every click brings you closer to mango madness! 🌴 Key Features:

🥭 Harvest Mangos – Click, upgrade, and collect mountains of mangos to climb the leaderboards!

🐣 Hatch Rare Pets – Unlock and level up adorable companions from mysterious eggs, each with unique abilities.

🎒 Equip More Pets – Power up your team with gamepasses like +3 Pets and build your dream squad.

🔄 Trade With Others – Dive into a vibrant player economy and swap pets and items with your friends.

🌟 Explore Colorful Worlds – Unlock new zones filled with surprises, stronger pets, and rarer mangos.

Whether you're a collector, a trader, or just here to relax and click mangos under the sun, Mango Simulator is bursting with fun for every player.

Are you ready to peel back the layers and become the mango legend? 

Codes: FreeCash, Mango, ting li
